text: Every time you step into a supermarket, you have one mission: grab what you need and get out efficiently. You're navigating a familiar landscape, often in a hurry.
So you reach for that popular item, perfectly at your eye level. It's easy, convenient, and you don't even think twice about it.
But have you ever noticed a pattern? The most recognizable, pricier brands always seem to land right in your line of sight. Coincidence?
Not at all. This is sophisticated visual merchandising. Retailers know your gaze naturally settles at eye-level, especially when you're rushed.
The consequence? You're subtly nudged towards higher-margin items, paying more for convenience without consciously deciding to. It's a quiet drain.
Next time you shop, armed with this insight, your eyes will scan the entire shelf, up and down. You’ll see the whole system, and you won't be easily swayed.
